_comment: Evaluation set for the document → target extraction pipeline (scripts/eval_extraction.py).
docPath is relative to the repo root and points into the OneDrive-synced SharePoint mirror
(dev_data_scripts/sharepoint_sync), which is NOT committed: the harness fails with a clear
message when the symlink is unmounted.
Tiers: 1 = quote-anchored gold (curated sources[].sourceText reachable in the local PDF);
2 = text-similarity gold only (gold quotes were composed by the CO from Excel rows, not
copied from the document); 3 = parse-stats fixture only (no extraction, no gold).
- Mongolia FSS: its targets are quoted in the few-shot examples of the extraction prompt (contaminated).
- Mongolia Vision 2050 (SECTORAL): the curated gold itself carries _provenanceFlag as paraphrased.
- Panama ENR: 263 MB REDD+ document, 206 gold targets; optional stress test, not part of the standard set.
- Panama NP against the local PDF: 0/36 gold quotes reachable (partial text layer; gold was
transcribed from the UNFCCC-published version). Kept as the tier-3 partial-text-layer fixture.

documents.docPath: dev_data_scripts/sharepoint_sync/Panama/Panama Materials/Policy docs shared by CO April 2026/Plan Nacional de Seguridad Hídrica.pdf
documents.notes: Strongest gold doc: 16/17 quotes reachable; 170 pages of Spanish; gold contains CO transcription typos, so matching must stay fuzzy. Also the runtime stress case.

8/8 gold quotes reachable. The ILDN gold does NOT come from the LDN TSP Country Report.

documents.notes: Gold quotes are CO-composed (concatenated Excel action rows stamped textCleanup=verbatim by the ingest script); only ~13% of quote 4-grams appear contiguously in the PDF. Text-similarity matching only; never gates acceptance.

documents.docPath: dev_data_scripts/sharepoint_sync/Panama/Panama Materials/Policy docs shared by CO April 2026/Pacto-de-Panama-con-la-Naturaleza-Nature-Pledge.pdf
documents.notes: Real-world partial-text-layer fixture (20/39 pages with <30 extractable chars). Excluded from recall; exercises the scanned-page detection. Gold recovery option: download the UNFCCC-published version referenced by the corpus sourceUrl and re-check reachability.
